business: Mitra (beta), a collab marketplace for Bengaluru Instagram creators
by_segment: Nano creator (2K-10K followers), student or day job, mostly barter so far
Established local creator (50K-100K followers), collabs are real income, may have a manager
Micro creator (10K-50K followers), does a few paid collabs a month
why_not: I've been burned by 'agencies' that took a fee and vanished, and a beta app with a small team asking me to connect my Instagram feels like the same story with a nicer website. I might poke at the free month, but I'm not paying for a pass until I see real paid leads, not cafés offering free dosa.

It's free this month so I might connect my Instagram and look around, but I'm not committing to the ₹499 pass. My WhatsApp groups already send me collab leads for nothing, and I've seen these apps launch with zero businesses on them.

I'd probably connect my account during the free month to see which brands show up, but I've never paid for a creator tool and I'm not starting now. Collabs already land in my DMs, and my manager handles the good ones.

I already apply to campaigns on Influish and barter offers from cafes land in my DMs every week, so I don't see why I'd pay for another app. I might connect Instagram while it's free to see what it shows me, but I wouldn't commit to the ₹499 pass.

Cafés and brands already slide into my DMs with barter offers, and I barely have time to edit reels after my day job, let alone browse another app. I might connect it during the free month out of curiosity, but I don't see myself paying when the deals find me anyway.
why_yes: It's free for the month and read-only, so I'll sign up and see if it throws up local brands my WhatsApp groups don't already pass around. But I'm not switching on Auto-DM, and if the matches are the same cafés everyone already pitches, I won't pay the ₹499.

It's free for a month and ₹499 a year is nothing next to what one collab pays me, so I'd connect my account and see if the auto-DM and brand matches actually grow my reach. I'm not dropping my manager or my own DMs for it, though.

It's free for the month and the read-only Instagram connect means I'm not filling forms, so I'd sign up and see if the matches beat what my four WhatsApp groups already throw at me. The comment-to-DM thing is the bit I actually want, because more people DMing me off a reel is reach, and reach is what I'm after right now.

It's free for the month and it's just a Google sign-in, so I'd connect my Insta and see what it finds for me. But I'd treat it like Influish: tap Interested, wait, and only pay ₹499 later if a café actually pays me money and not just a free dosa.
